scene: You step off the retro streetcar into steamy Bathhouse Chimney Street.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view on level cobblestones. On the far left waits the green retro streetcar. To the left is the blue-curtained bathhouse door with wooden clogs. At centre, the grandfather holds his bicycle with plant crates beside a squat milk vending robot. To the right, sleeping cats rest on low steam pipes.
shown: a blue curtained bathhouse doorway with wooden clogs outside on the left
a squat milk vending robot dispensing bottles in the centre
a sleepy calico cat curled atop brass steam pipes on the right

variants.scene: The streetcar hums away, leaving you under tall chimneys puffing sweet lavender smoke.
Paper lanterns glow softly as dusk settles over this cozy, quiet bathhouse alley.
You arrive at the bathhouse, still humming {tune} while pushing your flower bike.
